title: Elen Stirling Memorial
memorial_details: Memorial stone and tablet at the crash site, Elen (Dilsen), Limburg.
narrative: Stirling EE873 of 90 Squadron (coded XC), coded WP-D, departed Wratting Common at 2346 on 13 July 1943 for Aachen. The aircraft was intercepted at 4000m, 2km north-east of Rotem, by Hauptmann Heinrich Wohlers of Stab IV/NJG4 (detachment 3/NJG1) and shot down at 0148 on 14 July, his 17th claim. The aircraft crashed between Dilsen and Elen. Eight of the nine crew were killed; one survived as a prisoner of war.
cause_of_loss: Shot down by night fighter — Hptm Heinrich Wohlers (Stab IV/NJG4 det. 3/NJG1), his 17th claim
